name: Quikwit – AI Chatbot
author: quikwit

sections.description:
The Quikwit AI Chatbot plugin adds a fully customizable, self-learning AI-powered chatbot to your website.

It securely processes your site content to train its conversational model, helping you to engage visitors, answer customer questions, generate leads, and improve support 24/7.

Key Features:

  • Self-learning AI chatbot trained on your website content

  • Quick setup – no coding required

  • Fully customizable chat widget to match your brand

  • Engage visitors, generate leads, and improve support

  • Lightweight and optimized for performance

Third-Party Service Documentation (Guideline 6 Compliance)

This plugin relies on the Quikwit Platform (https://quikwit.chat/) to provide its core conversational AI functionality.

What the service provides:
The external Quikwit API hosts the generative AI model responsible for answering visitor questions, which is trained on your website’s data.

Data Sent to the Quikwit API:

Site Content (One-Time / Update):

Data Sent: Your website’s publicly available text content (pages, posts, and specified URLs) is sent to the Quikwit API.

When Sent: This occurs only during the initial chatbot setup (training) and subsequently when you manually trigger a content synchronization/re-index in the plugin settings. This content is used only to train your specific chatbot’s knowledge base.

Visitor Conversation Data (Per Interaction):

Data Sent: The visitor’s input question, the current conversation history (to maintain context), and the originating IP address (used for rate-limiting and regional performance routing).

When Sent: This occurs every time a website visitor interacts with the Quikwit chatbot widget.

Legal and Contact Information:

Service Terms: https://quikwit.chat/

Privacy Policy: https://quikwit.chat/

Contact: You can contact the service provider at contact@osnnova.com for data privacy inquiries.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin and upload it to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in your dashboard.

  3. Configure your chatbot settings in the Quikwit menu from the admin dashboard.

  4. The chatbot will appear automatically on your website.
sections.faq:
Do I need coding knowledge to use Quikwit?

No, Quikwit is designed for non-technical users. Setup takes just a few clicks.

Does the chatbot work on mobile devices?

Yes, the chat widget is fully responsive and works seamlessly across devices.

Does this require an external service?

Yes, the chatbot is powered through the Quikwit platform to provide AI-generated responses.

Where can I find the Quikwit settings?

After activation, look for the dedicated Quikwit menu item in your administration sidebar.
